newsitem.title: USA: Greif to buy Kyowva Corrugated Container.
newsitem.headline: Greif to buy Kyowva Corrugated Container.

text.p: Industrial packaging company Greif Brothers Corp said on Tuesday it had agreed in principle to acquire the stock of West Virginia-based Kyowva Corrugated Container Company for an undisclosed sum.
Kyowva employed 145 people and had plants in Huntington, West Virginia, and Winchester, Kentucky, Greif said in a statement.
Greif Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Michael Gasser said the acquisition complemented Greif's existing corrugated operations. -- New York newsdesk 859 1610
